gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Noto Sans Thai Looped looks loud on the line, its lowercase bodies stretched upward with generous gaps at the curve ends. Wallpoet comes in above it, bold and commanding, a display heading with a stencil-like gap running through its letters.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Wallpoet cuts a gap straight through its letters, like a stencil. Noto Sans Wancho sits beneath it in a hulking lowercase, pressed down like thick chalk, while the heading does its loudest work big and brief.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-yi: Modern and level-headed, Noto Sans Yi gives its lowercase a deep midsection and rounds left open like an unlatched hook. And Wallpoet above it stays bold and commanding, so a long paragraph feels like a quiet answer to a loud title.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-s: Bold up top, breezy below. Wallpoet carries a stencil-style gap through its letters, and Noto Sans Zanabazar Square follows with a soaring x-height and wide gaps, so a long stretch of text reads crisp and approachable.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-numans: Numans spreads its letters wide, with s shapes whose ends hang far from the spine and lowercase swollen like coiled rope. Wallpoet is the one for commanding display work, while Numans is the one for stretching out a line of text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-onest: Approachable describes Onest, with short ascenders over big bowls and a gentle monotone of line thickness, like a fixed pen. Wallpoet above it is the bold, commanding foil.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-open-sans: Heavy, stencil-cut and commanding, Wallpoet announces itself with a gap running through its lettering. Open Sans follows with a smooth, bulky lowercase.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads cleanly, its curves never closing back on themselves and its lowercase nearly matching the capitals in size. But Wallpoet is the louder of the two, a bold, commanding display face where Oxygen simply carries text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-puritan: Puritan draws rounded forms that stay clearly open to the side, with oversized e and a counters that feel generous. Wallpoet above it is bold and commanding.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada reads steadily, its c, s and z standing full and every curve finishing with a clear opening. And Wallpoet, bold and commanding above, leaves a long paragraph feeling like it follows a ruler-straight line.
